applies_to: every arm, challenger, control, discovery workstream and re-fit in the player model program that consumes experiments/player_program/feature_gate.py
principle: feature audits must run separately on EVERY chronological training fold and again on the FINAL ASSEMBLED DESIGN. A pooled audit cannot establish that every training fold is identified. Pooled variance is an average; identifiability is a per-fold property.

arguments_that_are_not_optional.target: enables target_derived, missingness_informative, one branch of missingness_encodes_outcome
arguments_that_are_not_optional.outcome_mask: enables the exact off-diagonal branch of missingness_encodes_outcome
arguments_that_are_not_optional.rule: an audit that omits an applicable argument is an INCOMPLETE audit, not a pass

motivating_case.pooled_audit_on_the_same_35629_rows: PASSED both columns with zero findings
motivating_case.downstream: |X.gamma| reached 6.9e4 and the within-team softmax saturated to exact 0.0 and 1.0 shares
motivating_case.optimiser: converged in five Newton iterations in every fold

pooled_healthy_fold_degenerate_rule: a feature healthy pooled but degenerate in a fold must FAIL for that fold, or be governed by a fallback frozen and registered before any result is visible. There is no third option.
convergence_is_not_evidence: a converging optimiser is NOT an acceptable substitute for any required check
recording_requirement: one machine-readable audit object per chronological training fold, keyed by fold identifier, plus one for the final assembled design, plus the argument set supplied to each call. ABSENCE OF THE PER-FOLD RECORD IS ITSELF A GATE FAILURE.
what_the_gate_does_NOT_catch: NONLINEAR DETERMINISTIC DEPENDENCY -- the rank/conditioning checks are SVD-based and the duplicate/collinearity checks are Pearson-based, both linear. A feature deterministic in the others through a nonlinear map (product, ratio, rank transform, threshold indicator, softmax share) can be exactly redundant while the design retains full numerical rank and unremarkable pairwise correlations. OPEN GAP.

ANYTHING THAT IS A PROPERTY OF THE COMPARISON RATHER THAN OF THE DESIGN MATRIX -- incumbent treatment, intercept treatment and penalisation, calibration freedom, clipping, evaluation-row alignment, companion components, fallback rules. Subject of the separate comparison_gate.py contract (integrity workstream A); this contract neither specifies nor assumes that module's interface beyond the name.
CONSTRUCTION-TIME PROVENANCE -- the gate sees the assembled matrix, not how it was built. Cutoff validity remains a registration and producer obligation.
status_of_a_passing_gate_record: NECESSARY, never SUFFICIENT. A passing record must never be cited as evidence that no unidentified or leakage-prone construction is present.
precedence: where this contract and an arm's registration disagree on invocation timing, this contract governs; where the registration is stricter, the stricter requirement governs; where this contract and feature_gate.py appear to disagree about what a check does, feature_gate.py governs
retrospective_note: had this contract and the current gate been in force at P2, arms E and I would have been blocked pre-fit on near_collinear and rank_deficient, and arms F and G on missingness_encodes_outcome.
